core_obligations: the first statement follows directly from the covariance theorem and the error bound of the conjugate gradient method
for the remaining statements work in the support-restricted space with kernel k_S and the corresponding objects
reuse the kernel-herding estimate: the deviation probability is bounded exponentially whenever n is large enough, giving a ball of radius delta/2 around the support mean
the second result follows because the method reduces the error at each step from the initial bound 2 |k|^{1/2}
the third statement iterates the geometric decay exp(-delta(t-1)/24|k|^{1/2}) and solves for t, producing the stated logarithmic step count
proof_roadmap: first statement from the covariance theorem
difficulty_reason: H2整链：1618-1663在support-restricted RKHS和最小affine face上把centered covariance的最小非零谱值转成均值邻域内球半径，1773-1804用uniform small-ball concentration把该半径传至empirical convex hull，3059-3135应用conditional-gradient的interior-ball指数下降得到O(log n) coreset、期望误差及stopping-time保证。无density/Lipschitz假设，区别于本组KH的density-based O(sqrt n)压缩目标，不是同命题或技术碎片。
